section_connections: S01 straight bay joins S02 at matched wall/cornice/sill end planes. S02 rear edge mates to S04 pier rear saddle. parts.name: Straight pointed arcade bay
parts.description: A joinable two-window section of the upper lower-wing wall: tall pointed blue/pink glass bays, thin ivory piers, rose triangular floral spandrels, fine gold arch edges, narrow pierced floral roof rail and plain shallow rear mating plane. No great gate or giant tower.

parts.name: Angled wing return bay
parts.description: A two-bay angled wall section matching the change of direction beside the projecting star pier. Preserve pointed windows and rose/ivory trim, a gentle mitred/faceted plan bend, contiguous wall and roof terrace shelf; not a separate square box.

parts.name: Lower stepped terrace arcade
parts.description: One short lower-level pointed arcade supporting a shallow roof terrace shelf with the source sloping/stepping retaining parapet and flower-bed coping. Keep the low garden-retaining front source contours; flower plants are separate. Do not raise this to the upper wall height.

parts.name: Projecting star-window pier
parts.description: The actual short projecting pale faceted pier: stepped square/faceted marble plinth, single tall blue star lancet, thin ivory corner piers, gold collar and a small open floral rail cap. It attaches to the wall at the rear. No onion or cone roof on this projection.

decor.name: Angled rail return
decor.description: One mitred floral pierced ivory/gold rail corner matching the wing bend, no full wall.

decor.name: Pier-to-rail end block
decor.description: Small carved end block where roof railing meets the star pier.

decor.name: Star-pier wall saddle
decor.description: Shallow moulded marble/gold rear junction pad receiving the neighboring wing cornice.

decor.name: Terrace corner bed coping
decor.description: Single angled rose/ivory bed-edge coping corner, gold lip.

decor.name: Stepped flower-bed edging
decor.description: Single short sloped marble bed-retaining edge with clean join ends; no plants.

decor.name: Rail end leaf clasp
decor.description: Tiny gilded leaf clasp at rail termination, one fitting.

decor.name: Stair side coping repeat
decor.description: One straight rose/ivory handrail-coping strip, gentle source incline; no stairs or wall.

decor.name: Turned stair coping corner
decor.description: One clean L-turn marble/gold coping segment meeting the landing.

decor.name: Stair bottom return shoe
decor.description: Small moulded foot return of the sloped stair parapet, separate.

decor.name: Stair head rail transition
decor.description: Small moulded transition from rising handrail to horizontal landing coping.

decor.name: Pier plinth front panel
decor.description: One source ivory marble rectangular panel with faint rose veining and fine moulded border.

decor.name: Pier plinth corner fillet
decor.description: One tall thin marble/gold corner edging piece for the projecting pedestal.

decor.name: Bed retaining-foot corner
decor.description: One low stepped moulded base corner for the terrace flower-bed edge.

decor.name: Planter pedestal seat
decor.description: One small pale square stone pedestal top and shallow stem for an existing planter, no new pot or flowers.

decor.name: Stair-end floral relief
decor.description: One restrained white/gold rose relief fitted to the stair parapet end.

decor.name: Arcade sill mitre return
decor.description: One short mitred ivory/rose/gold window-sill return matching the angled bay.

S02 top-right must be a gentle OBLIQUE convex wing return, TWO pointed window bays total, one on each face. The direction changes by about 30–45 degrees with a soft short faceted corner, never an L-shaped ninety-degree inward recess. Show the outward convex front face, its two window faces joined continuously across a slender moulded corner pier; one continuous matching roof rail, cornice and sill. Keep start and end mating surfaces clean and complete; no palace, fountain, glass, added floors or giant pedestals. Straight regular geometry, readable thin ornament and exact full printed captions beneath each part.
